institution_waivers.note: IBADAN requires five (5) credit passes including English Language, Biology/Agricultural Science, Chemistry, Mathematics and any one of Geography, Physics or Economics.

UMUDIKE accepts Five (5) 'O' Level credit passes at not more than two (2) sittings to include: English Language, Mathematics, Chemistry, Biology, or Agricultural Science and any other science subjects; requires at least 'O' Level pass in Physics. 'O' Level credit in Agricultural Science must be backed up with at least 'O' Level pass in Biology.
OOU, EKSU and ILORIN accept 'O' Level pass in Physics.
IMSU accepts 'O' Level pass in Mathematics, along with 'O' Level credit pass in Physics and vice versa.
ABU requires five (5) `O' level credit passes including English Language, Mathematics, Chemistry, Physics, Biology or Agricultural Science.
IBADAN, EKSU, ILORIN and TASUED require 'O' Level credit pass in Agricultural Science and a pass in Biology.
UDU and AAU accept 'O' Level pass in English Language.
BIU requires at least 'O' Level pass in Physics.
BAYERO requires five (5) `O' Level passes to include English Language, Mathematics, Chemistry any two (2) of Biology/Agric Science, Physics, Geography and Economics.
